runtime_gate.reason: Existing canonical F-host shared-runner heartbeat remains stale and height_difference_2 guarded operator recovery remains unexecuted.

score_basis: Candidate-specific reconciliation across LBBD committee records, Planning Data and current developer delivery updates, with outline, reserved-matters, brownfield and construction-state semantics kept separate and exact HMLR parcel geometry still required.

sources.label: Planning Data LBBD49/XJ
sources.fact: LBBD49/XJ identifies Former Ford Stamping Plant, 18.53ha, 3000-3502 net dwellings, outline-planning-permission, permissioned, with note Development commenced; geometry is blank and only a point is supplied.

sources.label: LBBD Planning Committee outline
sources.fact: Exact outline application is 21/01808/OUTALL for the former Ford Stamping and Tooling site, submitted by Peabody Trust and Dagenham Dock Ltd.

sources.label: LBBD outline capacity
sources.fact: Committee assessment describes up to 3502 homes and minimum 47% affordable provision on a habitable-room basis, stated as 1550 affordable homes.

sources.label: LBBD outline resolution
sources.fact: Committee resolved to delegate grant subject to any Mayor direction and completion of a section 106 agreement; committee resolution is not silently treated as an unconditional title-level consent event.

sources.label: LBBD Phase 1 reserved matters
sources.fact: Exact Phase 1 reserved-matters application is 22/01014/REM and explicitly relates to outline permission 21/01808/OUTALL.

sources.label: LBBD Phase 1 scope
sources.fact: Phase 1 covers Plots A, B and C, 935 dwellings, buildings ranging from 6 to 19 storeys and 1684.5sqm flexible non-residential/ancillary floorspace.

sources.label: Peabody Dagenham Green planning status
sources.fact: Peabody states outline permission was granted in October 2022 and describes the masterplan as 3502 homes on the former Ford site.

sources.label: Peabody first completed homes 2026
sources.fact: On 24 February 2026 Peabody reported the first 68 affordable-rent homes complete; Phase One totals 935 homes including 328 affordable homes.

sources.label: Peabody May 2026 construction milestone
sources.fact: On 26 May 2026 Peabody reported topping out of an 18-storey build-to-rent building and 360 rental homes across three buildings, confirming active construction but not completion of the whole masterplan.

sources.label: Peabody current Dagenham Green activity
sources.fact: Peabody's current news index lists June and July 2026 Dagenham Green milestones, supporting current project activity without substituting for statutory planning records.

sources.label: LBBD Local Plan 2037
sources.fact: LBBD confirms the 2037 Local Plan was adopted on 18 September 2024 and is the starting point for local decision-making.

sources.label: LBBD Development Plan
sources.fact: Current Development Plan comprises London Plan 2021, LBBD Local Plan 2037 and Joint Waste Development Plan; this plan status does not replace exact application or title evidence.

examples.result: XJ Brownfield 3502 maximum is reconciled with the exact outline application but is not an exact parcel capacity calculation.
21/01808/OUTALL is retained as the parent outline reference; 22/01014/REM is retained as a Phase 1 reserved-matters child, not a duplicate permission.
935 Phase 1 dwellings are not subtracted from or added to the 3502 outline total as a new independent site capacity.
The first 68 completed affordable homes prove partial delivery only, not completion of the 935-home phase or 3502-home masterplan.
The May 2026 topping-out milestone proves construction progress but not occupation, completion or current title ownership.
Planning Data's blank geometry is not replaced with a point buffer or masterplan illustration.
Committee resolution/S106 mechanics are not converted into exact title-boundary consent semantics.
Promotion remains zero until exact HMLR parcel/title relation and candidate-specific statutory overlays are executed and archived.
